## Skubal ERA 0.89 — Do You Understand How Insane This Is?

Look at this number. **ERA 0.89**. Do you know how many full-time starters have finished a season under 1.00 ERA since 2000? Zero. Pedro Martinez's legendary 2000 season was 1.74. Zack Greinke in 2009 posted 2.16 — considered one of the best in recent memory. Skubal is running **below both of those** right now.

And before you say it's luck — FIP is 1.23. BABIP is normal. This isn't smoke and mirrors. This is a generational pitching performance happening in real time.

BOS vs CWS — honestly, this one is straightforward. Garrett Crochet takes the mound, and the White Sox lineup is currently sitting at the bottom of the league in wRC+. The data is telling a clear story here. No drama needed.
